body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Vienna, Austria. The listing gives its length as 1 hours, over a route of about 1 km. It starts at Kunsthistorisches Museum, Maria-Theresien-Platz, Innere Stadt. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Skip-the-line Entry to the Kunsthistorisches Museum Wien. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Immerse yourself in the stunning beauty of European art and history with this captivating self-guided audio tour of the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna.
>
> Built in the late 19th century by Emperor Franz Joseph I, the Kunsthistorisches Museum in Vienna houses the extensive collections of the Habsburgs, one of Europe's most influential royal families. It is considered one of the world's most iconic museums and a must-visit destination for anyone interested in European art and history.
>
> This magnificent museum boasts an extensive collection of priceless artworks and artifacts from across the centuries. Explore the opulent halls and galleries and discover the stories and cultural significance behind the highlights of the collection.
>
> Marvel at the grandeur of the museum's architecture and admire the exquisite details of art pieces, from the Renaissance masters to the Baroque period and beyond. See the world-famous works of artists like Bruegel, Raphael, and Caravaggio and gain a deeper understanding of their artistic techniques.
